description: Defines the TpTimer class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace, implementing a timer with start, stop, interval, and callback functionalities.

classes.name: TpTimer
classes.description: A timer class that manages scheduling, callbacks, and single-shot or repeating timer behavior.

methods.name: TpTimer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the timer with default interval and state.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Returns whether the timer is currently active.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the timer and revokes scheduled jobs.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the timer with the current interval.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the timer with a specified interval in milliseconds.

methods.name: setSingleShot
methods.description: Sets whether the timer is single-shot or repeating.

methods.name: setInterval
methods.description: Sets the timer interval in milliseconds.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Assigns a callback function to be called on timer timeout.

methods.name: Timed
methods.description: Internal method invoked when the timer expires, executing the callback and managing timer state.
